cover_letter.greeting: Dear SuMi Trust Project Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Project Finance Summer Intern role covering Digital Infrastructure in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. AI and data center financing is the area I want to build my career in, and an internship inside a team that underwrites and monitors these loans is the best way I can think of to learn it.

The closest work I've done is an MBA project on a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio. I built project and portfolio models covering capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios, and compared senior debt, sustainability-linked loan and green loan plus ABS structures with downside sensitivities. Before the MBA, I managed cash flow analysis at Thomson Reuters covering 80%+ of total inflows, and at Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%.

That lines up with the credit analysis, model reviews and portfolio monitoring the internship describes. I haven't worked on a bank credit team yet, and I'd bring a solid modeling base plus Bloomberg and Capital IQ research to learn quickly. I'd welcome the chance to talk with the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Project Finance Summer Intern role on SuMi Trust's Digital Infrastructure team. For an MBA project I modeled a 35.4 MW solar portfolio, covering DSCR, levered IRR and debt structure options, and before that I ran cash flow analysis at Thomson Reuters. I'd love to hear how the team approaches data center financing. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
